title: Vox language-surface coverage ledger
description: CR-F3: maps every grammar production, decorator, and builtin to at least one behavioral fixture. Warn-mode scaffold — see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-08-vox-core-syntax-convergence-design.md S6. The hard CI gate (fail on missing coverage) lands in a later Sequencing Step, not this file.

mode.description: warn = informational only, no CI gate wired; enforce = CI fails on missing coverage (a later Sequencing Step).

fixture.description: Path to the behavioral fixture proving this production, e.g. a #[test] name or examples/golden/*.vox file. Required when status is 'covered'.

spec_ref.description: Section of the convergence spec that introduced this row, e.g. 'S2'.
